meta.title: Garden Security
meta.description: As they wander through the streets, they skillfully defuse an unexpected misunderstanding.

units.rawText: Gate 6, still under construction.
units.displayText: Gate 6, still under construction.

spans.text: Gate 6, still under construction.

units.rawText: CLANG!
units.displayText: CLANG!

spans.text: CLANG!

units.rawText: Jiangyu blocks a heavy swing from Croque. The sheer force drives her backwards a few steps, kicking up a great wave of dust.
units.displayText: Jiangyu blocks a heavy swing from Croque. The sheer force drives her backwards a few steps, kicking up a great wave of dust.

spans.text: Jiangyu blocks a heavy swing from Croque. The sheer force drives her backwards a few steps, kicking up a great wave of dust.

units.rawText: Haha, not bad at all. Is this a test of our skills? I'd better take this seriously, then.
units.displayText: Haha, not bad at all. Is this a test of our skills? I'd better take this seriously, then.

spans.text: Haha, not bad at all. Is this a test of our skills? I'd better take this seriously, then.

units.rawText: How dare you joke around after the mess you've made... <size=40>UNFORGIVABLE!</size>
units.displayText: How dare you joke around after the mess you've made... UNFORGIVABLE!

spans.text: How dare you joke around after the mess you've made...
UNFORGIVABLE!

units.rawText: I don't know what you're on about... did I miss something about the part leading up to here? Surely scripts are provided here for tryouts, right?
units.displayText: I don't know what you're on about... did I miss something about the part leading up to here? Surely scripts are provided here for tryouts, right?

spans.text: I don't know what you're on about... did I miss something about the part leading up to here? Surely scripts are provided here for tryouts, right?

units.rawText: Like hell if I'm going to back down in a fight, though! Take this!
units.displayText: Like hell if I'm going to back down in a fight, though! Take this!

spans.text: Like hell if I'm going to back down in a fight, though! Take this!

units.rawText: The two clash once more. On the other side, blades lock as Sakuya's open scissors are stuck on Aki's sword, the two at a standstill.
units.displayText: The two clash once more. On the other side, blades lock as Sakuya's open scissors are stuck on Aki's sword, the two at a standstill.

spans.text: The two clash once more. On the other side, blades lock as Sakuya's open scissors are stuck on Aki's sword, the two at a standstill.

units.rawText: Hey, Miss Sakuya, how about we have a reasonable conversation about this instead...
units.displayText: Hey, Miss Sakuya, how about we have a reasonable conversation about this instead...

spans.text: Hey, Miss Sakuya, how about we have a reasonable conversation about this instead...

units.rawText: You never gave us that courtesy when you did this to Horizon.
units.displayText: You never gave us that courtesy when you did this to Horizon.

spans.text: You never gave us that courtesy when you did this to Horizon.

units.rawText: You've got the wrong people! We've never done anything to her!
units.displayText: You've got the wrong people! We've never done anything to her!

spans.text: You've got the wrong people! We've never done anything to her!

units.rawText: Give up on the sophistry! I saw with my own eyes that you did something to Horizon, and she fell immediately afterwards!
units.displayText: Give up on the sophistry! I saw with my own eyes that you did something to Horizon, and she fell immediately afterwards!

spans.text: Give up on the sophistry! I saw with my own eyes that you did something to Horizon, and she fell immediately afterwards!

units.rawText: I do not enjoy the use of force, but I cannot condone harming Horizon. Remnant Leaves, blow!
units.displayText: I do not enjoy the use of force, but I cannot condone harming Horizon. Remnant Leaves, blow!

spans.text: I do not enjoy the use of force, but I cannot condone harming Horizon. Remnant Leaves, blow!

units.rawText: <size=28>Well, looks like we've been caught right in the middle of a trap...</size>
units.displayText: Well, looks like we've been caught right in the middle of a trap...

spans.text: Well, looks like we've been caught right in the middle of a trap...

units.rawText: Can you really afford to divert your attention!?
units.displayText: Can you really afford to divert your attention!?

spans.text: Can you really afford to divert your attention!?

units.rawText: As Aki whirls his blade to block the scattered leaves, he reveals an opening to Sakuya. She rapidly approaches, brandishing her weapon.
units.displayText: As Aki whirls his blade to block the scattered leaves, he reveals an opening to Sakuya. She rapidly approaches, brandishing her weapon.

spans.text: As Aki whirls his blade to block the scattered leaves, he reveals an opening to Sakuya. She rapidly approaches, brandishing her weapon.

units.rawText: <size=40>Aki!</size>
units.displayText: Aki!

spans.text: Aki!

units.rawText: Jiangyu's hollering does not change Aki's course of action even slightly. The scissors stop a few centimeters before they connect with Aki's still, unmoving chest.
units.displayText: Jiangyu's hollering does not change Aki's course of action even slightly. The scissors stop a few centimeters before they connect with Aki's still, unmoving chest.

spans.text: Jiangyu's hollering does not change Aki's course of action even slightly. The scissors stop a few centimeters before they connect with Aki's still, unmoving chest.

units.rawText: ...Why not dodge?
units.displayText: ...Why not dodge?

spans.text: ...Why not dodge?

units.rawText: Everyone present appears a bit too agitated. I must calm you down somehow.
units.displayText: Everyone present appears a bit too agitated. I must calm you down somehow.

spans.text: Everyone present appears a bit too agitated. I must calm you down somehow.

units.rawText: Aki places his weapon on the ground, signifying he is no longer a threat.
units.displayText: Aki places his weapon on the ground, signifying he is no longer a threat.

spans.text: Aki places his weapon on the ground, signifying he is no longer a threat.

units.rawText: Come on, Aki, don't do me like that!
units.displayText: Come on, Aki, don't do me like that!

spans.text: Come on, Aki, don't do me like that!

units.rawText: Sorry, could we have another chance to prove our abilities? We'll do everything we can for a spot in the wish fulfillment!
units.displayText: Sorry, could we have another chance to prove our abilities? We'll do everything we can for a spot in the wish fulfillment!

spans.text: Sorry, could we have another chance to prove our abilities? We'll do everything we can for a spot in the wish fulfillment!

units.rawText: A wish?
units.displayText: A wish?

spans.text: A wish?

units.rawText: Sakuya suddenly remembers something, immediately turning to Jiangyu.
units.displayText: Sakuya suddenly remembers something, immediately turning to Jiangyu.

spans.text: Sakuya suddenly remembers something, immediately turning to Jiangyu.

units.rawText: Yeah! [Festival's Big Reveal - Participate, and get a chance to fulfill a wish]... that's what we came here for!
units.displayText: Yeah! [Festival's Big Reveal - Participate, and get a chance to fulfill a wish]... that's what we came here for!

spans.text: Yeah! [Festival's Big Reveal - Participate, and get a chance to fulfill a wish]... that's what we came here for!

units.rawText: The post never said anything about a test of abilities, though. If only I knew earlier...
units.displayText: The post never said anything about a test of abilities, though. If only I knew earlier...

spans.text: The post never said anything about a test of abilities, though. If only I knew earlier...

units.rawText: Then Horizon...
units.displayText: Then Horizon...

spans.text: Then Horizon...

units.rawText: You mean that Doll who stood stone still in a weird position? All we did was touch her, and she just collapsed. Was that... not a part of the set you guys arranged?
units.displayText: You mean that Doll who stood stone still in a weird position? All we did was touch her, and she just collapsed. Was that... not a part of the set you guys arranged?

spans.text: You mean that Doll who stood stone still in a weird position? All we did was touch her, and she just collapsed. Was that... not a part of the set you guys arranged?

units.rawText: ...What do you make of it, Sakuya?
units.displayText: ...What do you make of it, Sakuya?

spans.text: ...What do you make of it, Sakuya?

units.rawText: ...It's all a bit far-fetched, but she doesn't seem to be lying to us.
units.displayText: ...It's all a bit far-fetched, but she doesn't seem to be lying to us.

spans.text: ...It's all a bit far-fetched, but she doesn't seem to be lying to us.

units.rawText: Croque and Sakuya share a look, slowly sheathing their weapons. Aki breathes a sigh of relief as those scissors leave his vicinity.
units.displayText: Croque and Sakuya share a look, slowly sheathing their weapons. Aki breathes a sigh of relief as those scissors leave his vicinity.

spans.text: Croque and Sakuya share a look, slowly sheathing their weapons. Aki breathes a sigh of relief as those scissors leave his vicinity.

units.rawText: Phew, I knew there was some sort of misunderstanding. When we got here, the door had already been destroyed, and we saw no other staff. We thought it was all done on purpose.
units.displayText: Phew, I knew there was some sort of misunderstanding. When we got here, the door had already been destroyed, and we saw no other staff. We thought it was all done on purpose.

spans.text: Phew, I knew there was some sort of misunderstanding. When we got here, the door had already been destroyed, and we saw no other staff. We thought it was all done on purpose.

units.rawText: Sakuya, how's Horizon?
units.displayText: Sakuya, how's Horizon?

spans.text: Sakuya, how's Horizon?

units.rawText: She's in no danger, just in hibernation. She was placed in this position via unnatural means, and it follows that she'd topple uncontrollably when touched.
units.displayText: She's in no danger, just in hibernation. She was placed in this position via unnatural means, and it follows that she'd topple uncontrollably when touched.

spans.text: She's in no danger, just in hibernation. She was placed in this position via unnatural means, and it follows that she'd topple uncontrollably when touched.

units.rawText: Appears you weren't lying. Look, that post is all fake, okay?
units.displayText: Appears you weren't lying. Look, that post is all fake, okay?

spans.text: Appears you weren't lying. Look, that post is all fake, okay?

units.rawText: Huh?!
units.displayText: Huh?!

spans.text: Huh?!

units.rawText: The person making the post was an impersonator. If my guesses are correct, the post was made with the intention of luring you here to distract us.
units.displayText: The person making the post was an impersonator. If my guesses are correct, the post was made with the intention of luring you here to distract us.

spans.text: The person making the post was an impersonator. If my guesses are correct, the post was made with the intention of luring you here to distract us.

units.rawText: They're bound to have already made their way deep into the event grounds. We'll have to root them out as soon as possible.
units.displayText: They're bound to have already made their way deep into the event grounds. We'll have to root them out as soon as possible.

spans.text: They're bound to have already made their way deep into the event grounds. We'll have to root them out as soon as possible.

units.rawText: So since that event's fake, the whole wish thing was a lie, too?
units.displayText: So since that event's fake, the whole wish thing was a lie, too?

spans.text: So since that event's fake, the whole wish thing was a lie, too?

units.rawText: Of course. The organizers are about as busy as they can be; there's not a single hand to spare for any other events.
units.displayText: Of course. The organizers are about as busy as they can be; there's not a single hand to spare for any other events.

spans.text: Of course. The organizers are about as busy as they can be; there's not a single hand to spare for any other events.

units.rawText: If you were misled here, you'd best be off. Sakuya, you escort them and go activate the observation tower. I'll go track down who's really responsible.
units.displayText: If you were misled here, you'd best be off. Sakuya, you escort them and go activate the observation tower. I'll go track down who's really responsible.

spans.text: If you were misled here, you'd best be off. Sakuya, you escort them and go activate the observation tower. I'll go track down who's really responsible.

units.rawText: No, no, hang on.
units.displayText: No, no, hang on.

spans.text: No, no, hang on.

units.rawText: How did it all turn out like this...
units.displayText: How did it all turn out like this...

spans.text: How did it all turn out like this...

units.rawText: Sakuya looks at Jiangyu's dejected figure as the latter draws circles on the ground, giving her a pat on the back.
units.displayText: Sakuya looks at Jiangyu's dejected figure as the latter draws circles on the ground, giving her a pat on the back.

spans.text: Sakuya looks at Jiangyu's dejected figure as the latter draws circles on the ground, giving her a pat on the back.

units.rawText: Do you have any wishes you particularly want fulfilled?
units.displayText: Do you have any wishes you particularly want fulfilled?

spans.text: Do you have any wishes you particularly want fulfilled?

units.rawText: Sakuya?
units.displayText: Sakuya?

spans.text: Sakuya?

units.rawText: Croque, we could use help. Horizon is unfit, the security team is tied down by agents unaware of the circumstances, and we do not have enough personnel here.
units.displayText: Croque, we could use help. Horizon is unfit, the security team is tied down by agents unaware of the circumstances, and we do not have enough personnel here.

spans.text: Croque, we could use help. Horizon is unfit, the security team is tied down by agents unaware of the circumstances, and we do not have enough personnel here.

units.rawText: If what she wants isn't particularly difficult to manage, perhaps we could get some assistance.
units.displayText: If what she wants isn't particularly difficult to manage, perhaps we could get some assistance.

spans.text: If what she wants isn't particularly difficult to manage, perhaps we could get some assistance.

units.rawText: ...Well, you're not wrong.
units.displayText: ...Well, you're not wrong.

spans.text: ...Well, you're not wrong.

units.rawText: What of it, then? What kinda wish do you have?
units.displayText: What of it, then? What kinda wish do you have?

spans.text: What of it, then? What kinda wish do you have?

units.rawText: Ah... a wish I have? It's a bit complicated to describe...
units.displayText: Ah... a wish I have? It's a bit complicated to describe...

spans.text: Ah... a wish I have? It's a bit complicated to describe...

units.rawText: Complicated?
units.displayText: Complicated?

spans.text: Complicated?

units.rawText: But we can sort it out after everything's settled! Let me help out first.
units.displayText: But we can sort it out after everything's settled! Let me help out first.

spans.text: But we can sort it out after everything's settled! Let me help out first.

units.rawText: Since it looks like we caused trouble for you with something we messed up, just think of it as repayment! Ol' Sis always taught me to make amends for my mistakes.
units.displayText: Since it looks like we caused trouble for you with something we messed up, just think of it as repayment! Ol' Sis always taught me to make amends for my mistakes.

spans.text: Since it looks like we caused trouble for you with something we messed up, just think of it as repayment! Ol' Sis always taught me to make amends for my mistakes.

units.rawText: When you put it like that, we are in no position to refuse...
units.displayText: When you put it like that, we are in no position to refuse...

spans.text: When you put it like that, we are in no position to refuse...

units.rawText: How about this, Sakuya? Me and you go and use the observation tower to take care of the big issue at hand.
units.displayText: How about this, Sakuya? Me and you go and use the observation tower to take care of the big issue at hand.

spans.text: How about this, Sakuya? Me and you go and use the observation tower to take care of the big issue at hand.

units.rawText: You two go track down the other intruders in the venue, whether it's the person behind all of this or other agents who were tricked like you. Just tie all of 'em up or something.
units.displayText: You two go track down the other intruders in the venue, whether it's the person behind all of this or other agents who were tricked like you. Just tie all of 'em up or something.

spans.text: You two go track down the other intruders in the venue, whether it's the person behind all of this or other agents who were tricked like you. Just tie all of 'em up or something.

units.rawText: When everything else is settled, we'll talk about how to realize that wish of yours, alright?
units.displayText: When everything else is settled, we'll talk about how to realize that wish of yours, alright?

spans.text: When everything else is settled, we'll talk about how to realize that wish of yours, alright?

units.rawText: Manual labor, huh? Exactly what I'm best at! Leave it to me!
units.displayText: Manual labor, huh? Exactly what I'm best at! Leave it to me!

spans.text: Manual labor, huh? Exactly what I'm best at! Leave it to me!

units.rawText: Feels like there's more trouble... sigh, I suddenly feel like a midday nap—
units.displayText: Feels like there's more trouble... sigh, I suddenly feel like a midday nap—

spans.text: Feels like there's more trouble... sigh, I suddenly feel like a midday nap—

units.rawText: We'll leave that to you. Me and Croque will be off.
units.displayText: We'll leave that to you. Me and Croque will be off.

spans.text: We'll leave that to you. Me and Croque will be off.

units.rawText: Before Aki finishes his lamentations, Sakuya stuffs maps of the venue into the pair's hands and hurries away with Croque.
units.displayText: Before Aki finishes his lamentations, Sakuya stuffs maps of the venue into the pair's hands and hurries away with Croque.

spans.text: Before Aki finishes his lamentations, Sakuya stuffs maps of the venue into the pair's hands and hurries away with Croque.
